title: lucy Runway
description: A project (a repository) inside an airspace. Stub: later slices add fields.

repository.description: The repository, for example owner/name on the forge.

autonomyPolicy.description: The AutonomyPolicy, in the Runway's namespace, whose level sets the project's merge posture. With autonomyLevel; a Flight's autonomy may then only tighten it.

autonomyLevel.description: The level of autonomyPolicy the project is at. Only that level's guardrails.requireApproval is read: all is the owner posture, security-critical-only the green posture. The owner changes it by hand: lucy promotes and demotes nothing.

clientConfirms.description: Merges need the client's confirmation, relayed by the owner (the client posture), on top of the owner's word. lucy's own: the spec has no such concept.
